overnightPermit.where: A Northwest Forest Pass, an America the Beautiful interagency pass, or a Recreation.gov day pass covers parking at the Cutthroat Creek and Blue Lake trailheads; no permit paperwork is needed to camp. Overnight camping is banned within a quarter mile of both Blue Lake and Cutthroat Lake.

A Northwest Forest Pass, an America the Beautiful pass, or a Recreation.gov day pass covers parking at the Rainy Pass PCT North trailhead; no permit paperwork is needed to camp anywhere along this stretch of the Pacific Crest Trail.
